references.title: Matplotlib Axes methods — set_title, xticks, axvline
references.summary: Official Matplotlib documentation for Axes methods — labels, ticks, limits, reference lines.
references.syntax:
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 5))
ax.plot(x, y)

# Заголовок и подписи
ax.set_title('Sales by Month', fontsize=14)
ax.set_xlabel('Month')
ax.set_ylabel('Revenue')

# Повернуть метки оси X
plt.xticks(rotation=45, ha='right')
# или через axes:
ax.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# Пределы осей
ax.set_xlim(0, 100)
ax.set_ylim(0, 500)

# Вертикальная / горизонтальная линия
ax.axvline(x=50, color='red', linestyle='--', label='Threshold')
ax.axhline(y=200, color='gray', linestyle=':')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

references.title: plotly.graph_objects — go.Figure, add_trace, update_layout
references.summary: Official Plotly documentation for graph_objects — low-level API with full control over traces and layout.
references.syntax:
import plotly.graph_objects as go

# Создать фигуру и добавить трассы
fig = go.Figure()
fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=df['date'], y=df['sales'],
                         mode='lines', name='Sales'))
fig.add_trace(go.Bar(x=df['category'], y=df['count'],
                     name='Count', marker_color='steelblue'))

# Настроить внешний вид
fig.update_layout(
    title_text='Dashboard',
    xaxis_title='Date',
    yaxis_title='Value',
    template='plotly_white'
)
fig.update_traces(opacity=0.8)
fig.show()

references.title: plotly.subplots.make_subplots
references.summary: Official Plotly documentation for creating figures with multiple subplots.
references.import:

import plotly.graph_objects as go
references.syntax:
from plotly.subplots import make_subplots
import plotly.graph_objects as go

# 2 строки, 2 столбца
fig = make_subplots(rows=2, cols=2,
                    subplot_titles=['A', 'B', 'C', 'D'])

fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=x, y=y1), row=1, col=1)
fig.add_trace(go.Bar(x=cats, y=vals), row=1, col=2)
fig.add_trace(go.Histogram(x=data), row=2, col=1)

fig.update_layout(height=600, title_text='Multi-panel')
fig.show()

references.title: sklearn.decomposition.PCA
references.summary: Official scikit-learn documentation for PCA — dimensionality reduction via principal component analysis.
references.syntax:
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

# Масштабировать перед PCA
X_scaled = StandardScaler().fit_transform(X)

# Сократить до 2 компонент
pca = PCA(n_components=2)
X_pca = pca.fit_transform(X_scaled)

# Объяснённая дисперсия
print(pca.explained_variance_ratio_)  # [0.72, 0.15]
print(pca.explained_variance_ratio_.sum())  # 0.87

references.title: pmdarima.auto_arima
references.summary: Official pmdarima documentation for auto_arima — automatically selects ARIMA orders.
references.syntax:
import pmdarima as pm

# Автоматически найти p, d, q
model = pm.auto_arima(series,
                      seasonal=True, m=12,  # m — период сезонности
                      stepwise=True,
                      information_criterion='aic',
                      trace=True)

print(model.summary())

# Прогноз
forecast, conf_int = model.predict(n_periods=12, return_conf_int=True)

references.title: sklearn.model_selection.cross_val_score
references.summary: Official scikit-learn documentation for evaluating a model using cross-validation.
references.syntax:
from sklearn.model_selection import cross_val_score
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression

model = LinearRegression()

# 5-fold кросс-валидация (CV=5)
scores = cross_val_score(model, X, y, cv=5, scoring='r2')
print(scores)         # [0.82, 0.79, 0.85, 0.81, 0.83]
print(scores.mean())  # среднее качество
print(scores.std())   # разброс (стабильность)

# Другие метрики
cross_val_score(model, X, y, cv=5, scoring='neg_mean_squared_error')
cross_val_score(clf, X, y, cv=5, scoring='accuracy')

references.title: sklearn.model_selection.GridSearchCV
references.summary: Official scikit-learn documentation for exhaustive search over specified parameter values for an estimator.
references.syntax:
from sklearn.model_selection import GridSearchCV
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier

# Сетка параметров для поиска
param_grid = {
    'n_estimators': [50, 100, 200],
    'max_depth': [None, 5, 10],
    'min_samples_split': [2, 5]
}

model = RandomForestClassifier(random_state=42)
gs = GridSearchCV(model, param_grid, cv=5, scoring='accuracy', n_jobs=-1)
gs.fit(X_train, y_train)

print(gs.best_params_)   # {'max_depth': 10, 'n_estimators': 100, ...}
print(gs.best_score_)    # 0.87
best_model = gs.best_estimator_

references.title: sklearn.pipeline.Pipeline
references.summary: Official scikit-learn documentation for chaining estimators into a single pipeline object.
references.syntax:
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression

# Создать пайплайн
pipe = Pipeline([
    ('scaler', StandardScaler()),    # шаг 1: нормализация
    ('model', LogisticRegression())  # шаг 2: модель
])

# fit и predict как обычно
pipe.fit(X_train, y_train)
predictions = pipe.predict(X_test)

# Краткий синтаксис
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
pipe = make_pipeline(StandardScaler(), LogisticRegression())

# Использование с GridSearchCV
param_grid = {'model__C': [0.1, 1, 10]}
gs = GridSearchCV(pipe, param_grid, cv=5)
